prompts_description: Manage shared prompts and persona instructions.
prompts_agent_description: Allow WebUI Chat and coding workspaces to read and change shared prompts and personas.
auth_not_configured: No administrator is configured yet. Set TSUKAIMA_ADMIN_USERNAME and TSUKAIMA_ADMIN_PASSWORD (at least 8 characters), then restart the server.
auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
auth_sign_in_failed: Sign-in failed. Check the server logs.
chats_empty: No chats yet. Start a local Tsukaima chat or wait for a channel message.
command_abort_description: Abort an active reply, clear queued inputs, and cancel pending delayed outbound messages.
command_abort_done_cancelled: Run aborted and pending reply cancelled
command_archive_receiving_hint: Select another receiving session before archiving.
command_compact_description: Summarize older model turns into a compact summary while keeping recent turns and full chat history.
command_compact_instructions_placeholder: Optional focus instructions (e.g. keep task progress)
command_compact_noop: Nothing to compact yet — recent turns still fit inside the window.
command_memory_compact_description: Extract and merge recent turns in this session into durable memory records.
command_reset_confirm_prompt: Start a fresh model context? Older turns will no longer be sent to the model.
command_reset_description: Start a clean model context window from this point forward. Chat messages in the UI are preserved.
command_reset_handoff_placeholder: Optional handoff note for the new context
command_section_hint: Slash commands are disabled in chat; run session operations directly here.
composer_hint_channel: This sends directly to the external chat. It will not ask Tsukaima to reply.
composer_hint_tsukaima: This creates an Tsukaima turn in this session only.
composer_hint_workspace: Describe the task, or @ a conversation to include bounded context.
delivery_mode_follow_up_hint: Wait for the current turn to finish, then run separately.
delivery_mode_interrupt_hint: Stop the current generation immediately and answer this now.
delivery_mode_steer_hint: Inject into the active run after the current step finishes.
context_empty: No context data available for this session.
context_memories_disabled: Memory recall is disabled by policy.
context_memories_empty: No memories injected into this turn.
conversation_system_message: Fake runtime is wired to the conversation host.
diagnostics_logs_description: Structured tracing output streamed from the server.
diagnostics_logs_empty: No log entries match this view.
diagnostics_logs_search_placeholder: Filter by message, target, or field
diagnostics_page_description: Inspect channel state, processing health, model usage, and live runtime logs.
github_activity_description: Workflow runs for the current HEAD and the open pull requests.
github_cli_missing: The server image does not include the GitHub CLI. Rebuild it with gh installed.
github_description: Sign in with the GitHub CLI. The server starts gh auth login, keeps the session on the data volume, and never returns a token.
github_login_help: No OAuth App or Client ID is needed. The server runs the same device-code flow as gh auth login.
github_runs_empty: No workflow runs for this commit.
group_management_unavailable: Group management actions are not implemented yet.
groups_empty: No groups have been seen on a connected channel yet.
groups_select_description: Choose a group on the left to view its sessions and members.
model_choice_empty: No model catalog is available until a model provider is configured.
model_section_description: Override the model and reasoning effort for this conversation. Unset values follow the chat or workspace default.
memories_description: Review, search, pin, expire, revoke, and compact scoped memories. Raw memory content is never written to server logs.
memories_edit_description: Update the summary, content, importance, or expiry. Changes are audited without copying memory content into the audit log.
memories_list_description: Pending candidates can be approved or rejected. Pinning keeps a memory near the top of hybrid recall.
message_media_unavailable_hint: The media could not be downloaded. It may be retried later.
messages_empty: No messages in this session yet.
new_chat_description: A local chat has its own Tsukaima context. It does not create or modify an external QQ chat.
new_session_description: This adds a separate Tsukaima context under the same chat object. External history is not changed.
no_external_target: This local chat has no external destination.
plugins_config_configured: Configured; enter a new value to replace it
plugins_config_empty: This plugin has no configuration fields.
plugins_config_unsupported: Edit this value in the plugin configuration JSON.
plugins_custom_ui_notice: This plugin ships its own interface. It runs in the admin page and can read the administrator session.
plugins_enabled_hint: Disabled plugins stop their channels, tools, and RPC methods until enabled again.
plugins_no_custom_ui: This plugin has no custom interface. Its status and configuration appear here.
plugins_sidebar_description: Inspect installed plugins and open their controls.
plugins_toggle_failed: Could not change the plugin state
plugins_unknown_description: It may have been removed or renamed.
policy_allowed_tools_hint: Leave blank to allow every tool. Comma or newline separated names filter the tool list.
policy_allowlist_hint: Comma or newline separated user, group, or chat IDs.
policy_compaction_hint: Compaction starts at the trigger threshold. A background pass starts one more lead earlier; set it to 0 to disable background compaction. The effective threshold leaves room for the summary.
policy_compaction_preset_hint: Presets only replace the three thresholds above; other conversation defaults stay unchanged.
policy_compaction_trigger_hint: 0 = auto: context window minus reserve. A positive value overrides the reserve-based threshold.
policy_compaction_reserve_inactive: Ignored while a trigger threshold is set.
policy_description: Control when this conversation responds, how it aggregates bursts, and how replies are paced. Changes create a new audited policy revision.
policy_keywords_hint: A matching keyword counts as a direct address.
policy_reply_to_bot: Replying to the bot counts as direct
policy_cross_session_enabled: Show where the speaker was recently active in other chats
policy_cross_session_hint: Looks back over the speaker's own lines in other chats. Private chat text never reaches a group prompt unless the privacy mode allows snippets.
policy_cross_session_private_hint: Default is an indicator only: the model learns a recent private chat exists, never its text or title.
policy_memory_consolidation_hint: One idle-debounced background job per chat merges new messages into the rolling state. A malformed batch is dropped after this many failures.
policy_memory_consolidation_qa: Recall earlier answers to recurring questions
policy_self_aliases_hint: Names that count as addressing Tsukaima without an @ mention.
policy_sidechat_enabled: Let a sidechat interrupt a running reply
policy_sidechat_hint: While a reply is still generating, a fast model decides whether new messages should interrupt it, steer the running tool round, or wait and merge into one follow-up.
policy_sidechat_model_hint: Choose a chat model or a native decision model. Native decision models use the indicated server environment key.
policy_direct_flush: Send complete direct messages without waiting
policy_direct_flush_hint: A direct message that ends a sentence or is long enough skips the settle window, unless the sender is still typing in quick succession.
policy_narration: Send text written before a tool call right away
policy_recent_activity_hint: Whether undirected group messages may start a model turn while the bot was recently active.
policy_poke_wake: Reply when someone pokes the bot
policy_generation_hint: Sampling overrides apply to OpenAI-compatible requests only. Leave a field blank to use the provider model value.
policy_length_truncation: When the output limit is reached
policy_length_truncation_surface: Send the cut text and record truncation
policy_stop_sequences_hint: One per line, up to four. Leave blank to use the provider model value.
policy_workspace_delegation_hint: Let trusted admins in this chat spawn and message coding workspaces. Ordinary chats never receive repository coding tools.
policy_sandbox_workspace_hint: Let anyone in this chat spawn isolated document, file, and data sandboxes. Sandboxes have no network, repository, host data, or admin tools.
request_already_handled: This request has already been handled.
request_channel_offline: Connect the channel before handling this request.
request_confirm_description: This action changes the state on the external account. Review the requester and target before continuing.
requests_select_description: Choose a request on the left to view its details and handle it.
repository_description: The checkout this server runs in, as git sees it. This view is local: a branch can look pushed while the remote-tracking ref is stale.
repository_identity_failed: Could not save the git identity
repository_identity_help: Used for commits and merge commits the server creates, and for governed worktree commands.
repository_load_failed: Could not read the repository status
repository_pulled_and_restarting: Pulled; update restart scheduled in 1 minute
run_steps_empty: This turn produced no steps to show.
reply_decision_gate_reply: Group reply check · Continue to the main model
reply_decision_gate_fallback: Group reply check · Used the fallback policy
reply_decision_lurk: The assistant chose to stay silent
session_archived_notice: This session is archived and read-only.
session_not_found: This session does not exist or is no longer available.
session_receiving_explanation: New external messages are routed here.
settings_appearance_hint: Choose a light or dark color theme.
settings_language_hint: This preference is stored in this browser. The page reloads when the language changes.
settings_model_defaults_description: Chat and workspace sessions use these models and reasoning levels unless the conversation overrides them.
settings_model_defaults_empty: Configure a model provider before choosing defaults.
settings_memory_model_empty: No chat-capable model is available; background consolidation uses the deterministic fallback.
settings_memory_model_hint: Background memory consolidation uses this lightweight model when set; a conversation-level extract model still overrides it.
settings_page_description: Configure interface language, runtime logging, and conversation-wide defaults.
settings_policy_defaults_description: Applied to every conversation without its own override. Use Override all values to replace existing per-conversation overrides.
settings_policy_override_all_description: Write the current defaults to every conversation and replace all of its policy values. Each conversation gets a new audited revision.
settings_policy_override_all_warning: Per-conversation customizations will be replaced. Old revisions remain visible in policy history, but this action cannot be undone from here.
settings_restart_hint: Restart the server to apply pending settings.
settings_sidebar_description: Interface, runtime, conversation defaults, and upgrades.
settings_general_description: Interface language, logging, and model defaults.
settings_policies_description: Defaults applied to conversations without their own override.
settings_maintenance_description: Schedule or cancel a graceful restart and update window.
settings_upgrades_description: Compare the running checkout with its upstream branch, then merge or delegate the upgrade.
runtime_maintenance_description: Schedule a graceful shutdown. Every new chat turn receives the countdown before its prompt, and reserved resume hooks run after the supervisor starts the process again.
upgrade_description: Compare this checkout with the configured upstream. A clean checkout with no local commits is fast-forwarded. Local commits get a host-prepared proposal workspace; uncommitted changes must be committed or discarded first.
upgrade_dirty_description: The working tree has uncommitted changes. Commit or discard them before starting an upgrade.
upgrade_fast_forward_description: This checkout has no local commits. The upstream branch can be merged directly and the server restarted.
upgrade_history_empty: No upgrades have been started yet.
upgrade_proposal_required: Review the prepared proposal; finalizing re-checks the clean worktree and evidence before merging.
upgrade_reason_detached_head: The checkout is on a detached HEAD.
upgrade_reason_fetch_failed: The upstream remote could not be fetched.
upgrade_reason_invalid_branch: The current branch name cannot be used as a remote ref.
upgrade_reason_remote_not_configured: The configured upgrade remote does not exist.
upgrade_reason_upstream_branch_missing: The upstream does not have a branch with the current name.
upgrade_reason_working_tree_dirty: The working tree has uncommitted changes, so the upgrade must run in a workspace.
upgrade_workspace_description: The server prepares and snapshots the merge in a governed worktree. Finalizing re-checks the live revision, target integration, clean worktree, and proposal evidence before merging.
settings_sidechat_model_empty: No plugin advertises a sidechat-capable model; the active model is used instead.
settings_sidechat_model_hint: Native decision models use the indicated server environment key. Choose the active model to keep the conversation default.
users_select_description: Choose a user on the left to view identities, trust, chats, and groups.
welcome_description: Sessions are grouped under chat objects in the sidebar. Select a session to open its messages here.
workspace_goal_placeholder: Describe the bug, feature, or optimization with acceptance criteria…
workspace_git_unavailable: No worktree for this workspace yet.
workspace_new_description: The workspace gets a dedicated coding task and can inspect the running repository in a governed worktree.
workspace_rename_hint: The first message sets the title and mode tag.
workspace_welcome_description: Choose a workspace session on the left, or start one with a concrete engineering goal. Chat and workspace execution stay separated.
workspaces_empty: Spawn a workspace from chat or create one here with a concrete goal.
tasks_description: Durable reminders and scheduled turns linked to your conversations.
tasks_sidebar_description: Inspect and manage schedules without leaving the workspace.
tasks_empty: Create a reminder or schedule an agent turn for a conversation.
tasks_no_results: No scheduled tasks match this filter.
tasks_select_description: Select a task in the sidebar, or create a new one.
tasks_cancel_confirm: Cancel this task? History is retained.
policy_humanization_delay_curve: Hour & length shaped reply delay curve
policy_gate_ambient_group: Consider joining group chats without recent bot activity
policy_social_hint: Hard safety gates (quiet hours, refusal cooldown, unanswered silence, self-message ratio) still apply at every level.
policy_sidechat_interject_hint: Only urgent direct messages while a long turn is working; identity probes and follow-ups stay on the main conversation.
